result.question: Critically examine the procedure for amending the Constitution under Article 368.

directives.meaning: Look at the issue closely, weigh its strengths and weaknesses with evidence, and end with your own reasoned judgement.

sentences.text: Under Article 368, an amendment can be initiated by introducing a Bill in either House of Parliament.
It must be passed in each House by a majority of the total membership and two-thirds of the members present and voting.
Every constitutional amendment must also be ratified by the legislatures of at least half of the States.
This makes the Indian Constitution partly rigid and partly flexible.
